outcome: Pulsatility Index (PI) of the uterine artery
PI of the fetal middle cerebral artery
cohort: 35 women with singleton pregnancies between 18-33 weeks gestation who presented with preterm labor, asymptomatic short cervix, or a past medical history of preterm birth.
finding: Vaginal progesterone administration significantly reduced the Pulsatility Index (PI) in the uterine arteries, suggesting potential vasodilatory effects on uterine-fetal vessels.
